title: callable-type-assertions (clean-room semantics)

ground_truth.statement: Callable includes both object and string representations. is_string and is_object each have reachable outcomes and safely narrow the value.

notes: The local source is a lead, not an oracle. Fixture and deterministic controls are re-derived from PHP semantics. Constant-condition diagnostics measure broad behavior, not a recommendation that every redundancy deserves a product warning. Shares the existing semantic criterion. The new fixture adds assignment-context or callable-string controls; it is not a new criterion. Measured with PHP 8.3.35, PHPStan 2.3.1, Psalm 6.20.0 and Mago 1.57.0. phpstan agrees with the scoped expectation; psalm agrees with the scoped expectation; mago false_positive: unexpected diagnostic(s): impossible-condition@5, impossible-type-comparison@5, no-value@4, no-value@5.
